data: Does the performance of the NN model on the test set reach its peak at the same negative sample ratio as the development set?

The question asks whether the performance of the NN model on the test set reaches its peak at the same negative sample ratio as the development set. From the analysis of the figure:

1. The blue line represents the performance on the test set.
2. The red line represents the performance on the development set.
3. The peak performance on the test set appears around a negative sample ratio of 4.0.
4. The peak performance on the development set appears around a negative sample ratio of 6.0.

Since these two peaks do not occur at the same negative sample ratio, the answer is no.
